summary:
The iPad 5th gen (2017) has outlasted more load-shedding stages than most of us can count, and it's usually still worth fixing.

Glass-only repair is available on this model, so a cracked screen doesn't always mean a whole new display. A tired battery costs R850 to replace. If the Lightning port has stopped charging, we repair it with micro-soldering for typically R900 to R1,200, and your data stays in place.

Every repair starts with a free diagnostic at our workshop in Silvercrest Shopping Centre, Silvamonte, and carries a 6-month warranty. We use OEM-spec parts only.

Tap Call now to speak to us about your repair.
